subject: Vendor Enrollment: Bill-to mapping, PO windows, remittance & VAT evidence — HelionTech
messages:
From: Tom Berger <tom.berger@heliontech.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@heliontech.com>, AP Team <ap@heliontech.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Vendor enrollment questions — Redwood Inference

Hi Laura,

Thanks for starting the vendor enrollment — we saw the initial submission come through our vendor portal (portal id HT-99821). Our AP team reviewed Redwood's packet and had a couple of clarifying items before we finalize the vendor record:

1) Bill-to / Ship-to mapping: We need to confirm whether Redwood requires us to send POs to a specific legal entity ("Redwood Inference, Inc.") and whether multiple bill-to accounts will be in scope (US vs EU). Can you confirm the exact bill-to name(s) we should use on POs?

2) PO acceptance windows: Our system enforces a 14-day PO acceptance window for new vendors before POs auto-expire. Are Redwood invoices able to reference PO numbers dated up to 30 days prior to invoice submission if the PO acceptance window differs?

3) VAT evidence: HelionTech requires either a VAT certificate or evidence of reverse-charge eligibility for EU invoices. Can you provide your EU VAT number and a copy of the certificate?

4) Remit/bank format: We have a preferred bank remit csv import that needs: bank name, account name, IBAN/SWIFT, remittance email. Is Redwood able to supply that as a single PDF or CSV?

If easier, happy to hop on a 20-minute call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Tom
Tom Berger
Head of Procurement — HelionTech Inc.

[Internal note: portal ticket HT-99821]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Tom Berger <tom.berger@heliontech.com>
Cc: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@heliontech.com>, aditya.rao@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-18T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment questions — Redwood Inference

Hi Tom — thanks for the clear list. Answers below and attaching the vendor packet + bank details: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_v2.pdf and Redwood_W9_and_Bank_Details.pdf.

1) Bill-to / legal entity
- Primary bill-to: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (US payable entity).
- Secondary EU billing: "Redwood Inference Europe Ltd." — please only use the EU entity for invoices issued to HelionTech EU entities.
- For PO line mapping, include the bill-to legal entity exactly as one of the two names above.

2) PO acceptance windows
- We generally accept POs tied to invoices up to 30 days prior to invoice date. If your AP system enforces a 14-day auto-expiry, we can accept a PO dated earlier as long as you have the PO number in the invoice and a portal note referencing the prior approval. For automated matching, we recommend enabling a manual override for Redwood for the first 6 months while we complete enrollment.

3) VAT evidence
- Attached: EU_VAT_Certificate_Redwood.pdf (EU VAT number: GB999888777). If HelionTech intends to apply reverse-charge, include the reverse-charge annotation on the invoice line item and reference our VAT number.

4) Remit format
- Attached PDF includes bank name, account name, IBAN, SWIFT, and remittance@redwood.com as the remittance contact. If you prefer a csv template, please send it and we will return it populated.

Next steps: I can sign the portal enrollment and return any portal-specific form — I see a DocuSign link in your portal; if you share it, I'll route to finance for signature. Looping in Aditya (finance ops) and Vivek (platform/legal) on details below.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head, Financial Ops — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

[Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_v2.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: Redwood_W9_and_Bank_Details.pdf (pdf)]

From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-18T11:29:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment questions — Redwood Inference

Thanks Laura — quick notes from finance ops:

- PO acceptance: we can add a portal note for HelionTech to allow POs older than 14 days for Redwood during the initial six-month onboarding window. We'll set a flag in our billing system to accept legacy POs with matching PO numbers.
- Invoicing frequency: we prefer monthly consolidated invoices (one invoice per month per bill-to entity) unless HelionTech requires per-PO invoice lines. Consolidated invoices reduce transaction costs.
- Tax treatment: Vivek, can you confirm whether Redwood will ever need to issue VAT-exclusive vs VAT-inclusive invoices for HelionTech EU?

Aditya Rao
Finance Ops — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

[Internal: will prepare the CSV template if they send the sample file]

> On 2026-05-18, at 11:02, laura.bennett@redwood.com wrote:
> > Attached: EU_VAT_Certificate_Redwood.pdf (EU VAT number: GB999888777).

From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
To: aditya.rao@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-18T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment questions — Redwood Inference

Confirming VAT posture:
- Redwood Inference, Inc. (US) issues USD invoices for US-headquartered HelionTech entities.
- Redwood Inference Europe Ltd. will issue GBP/EUR invoices to HelionTech EU entities and will include the EU VAT number on those invoices; standard VAT-exclusive presentation is supported where applicable.
- For reverse-charge: HelionTech should include the reverse-charge note on the invoice and reference our VAT number. We will not collect VAT when reverse-charge applies.

I'll approve the bank details and W-9 on record. No legal objections.

Vivek Kulkarni
General Counsel — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Sara Lopez <sara.lopez@heliontech.com>

Cc: Tom Berger <tom.berger@heliontech.com>, AP Team <ap@heliontech.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment questions — Redwood Inference

Hi Laura — thanks for the packet and quick answers. A couple follow ups from AP: 

1) Consolidated invoices: HelionTech's standard is to match at the PO level; consolidated invoices are allowed but we need a line-level PO mapping in the invoice so our system can auto-apply payments. Can Redwood include a PO column per line item and a summary table that maps invoice totals to PO numbers?

2) Bank remit CSV: attaching our CSV template export layout (ap_remit_template.csv). Please populate and return. Our import rejects if field order deviates.

3) Payment terms: Our default is Net 45 for new vendors; we offered Net 30 for a few strategic partners. Are you able to accept Net 45 for the first 90 days while enrollment completes?

4) Portal: The DocuSign link is live — please sign the enrollment agreement so we can push your vendor code.

Attaching: ap_remit_template.csv (CSV)

Sara Lopez
AP Manager — HelionTech
ap@heliontech.com

[Attachment: ap_remit_template.csv (csv)]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com

Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-05-20T09:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor enrollment questions — Redwood Inference

Hi Sara/Tom — appreciate the detail. Responses below and attached the populated csv.

1) Consolidated invoices / PO line mapping
- We can produce consolidated monthly invoices with a PO column per line item and a summary mapping table. Sample layout included in the vendor packet (page 4).

2) Bank remit CSV
- Attached: ap_remit_template_populated.csv (populated with Redwood's remit details). Please confirm import success.

3) Payment terms
- We can accept Net 45 for the first 90 days to align with your onboarding cadence. After stabilization, we'd like to move to Net 30 as standard (revisit at renewal).

4) DocuSign
- I signed the enrollment agreement and routed it to finance for countersignature — you should see a DocuSign envelope show up from dse@redwood.com.

Next: if your portal requires a "bill-to routing code" or internal ledger id to finalize, please send that field name/value and we'll push it into our billing system.

Thanks,
Laura

[Attachment: ap_remit_template_populated.csv (csv)]

Can you please confirm whether Redwood requires any special invoice header strings for auto-matching (e.g., "Invoice sent via HelionTech portal" or a specific payer reference)? If not, we'll proceed with standard layout.

Tom
